title: Senior Underwriter
location: New York, NY (must live in US)
why: E&S property, cat exposure (wind, flood, wildfire), wholesale brokers, P&C license. That is your Farmers E&S placement work plus Gulf Coast cat know-how.
gap: Says 'Senior' and wants cat-model / Excel comfort. Remote is implied ('must be located in the US'), not stated. Ask the recruiter.

title: Sr Underwriter - Commercial E&S Property
why: Cat-exposed E&S property through wholesale brokers, writes on Lloyd's paper. Your resume already lists E&S, MGA/MGU and Lloyd's market.
gap: Wants 7+ years commercial property UW or wholesale brokerage. You have 6.5 total, mostly personal lines. Stretch. 20% travel.

title: E&S Casualty - Senior UW Specialist (Hybrid/Remote)
location: 100% remote anywhere in US except CA/NY
why: Whole range is above your floor, truly remote, wholesale E&S desk. Title can be leveled down to 'Underwriter Specialty' to fit you.
gap: Casualty, not property. Wants 3-4 yrs driving agency relationships. Posted in June, so it may be filled. Apply fast or skip.

title: Underwriter-IM (Wholesale / E&S Commercial Lines)
why: Must-haves are 2 yrs insurance/UW/MGA plus a producer license. You clear both. Big carrier, pension, 20 days PTO.
gap: Remote not confirmed. 'Ideal' is 5 yrs commercial UW. Confirm remote before you spend time on it.

title: Small Business Renewal Underwriter & Portfolio Associate
why: Fully remote, 2-5 yrs, reviews property valuations and loss history. Very winnable.
gap: Bottom of range is under your floor. Ask for $78k+. They prefer Northeast/Midwest candidates.

title: Underwriter - Social Services Program
why: Remote wholesale underwriter seat, 2 yrs required.
gap: Range is wide and mostly under your floor. Old posting. Backup only.

title: Senior Compliance Analyst
gap: Accident & Health form filings. Not your lane.

title: Senior Claims Analyst
gap: Environmental/casualty claims and litigation. JD preferred. Long shot.

title: Business Analyst, P&C Insurance (Remote)
why: Remote, E&S team, pays over floor.
gap: Needs business analyst / Duck Creek systems work. Not your background.

title: Senior Property Treaty Reinsurance Underwriter
gap: Treaty reinsurance plus 40% travel. You'd need reinsurance experience. Not now.

title: Account Executive (Commercial Trucking)
gap: Trucking book plus AMS360 required. Wrong lane and low pay.

why: Cat property MGA, great pay, only 2 yrs required.
gap: Hybrid in Houston area. Filtered out for not being remote.

gap: In-person training, then up to 3 days home. Ohio.

title: Associate Underwriter
gap: In office, med-mal, and tops out under your floor.
